claim_updates.reason: Frozen decision_rule FAIL: C1 PASS (TP=1.0, all Wilson lower CI 0.886 > 0.75), C2 PASS (8/8 conditions with variance for both signals), C4 PASS (FP=0.0 on 120 noise-only samples), but C3 FAIL (permutation p=0.414 > 0.05 despite |r|=0.0527 < 0.3). The TP/variance trade-off identified in parent EXP-GRAPH-35237975537 IS broken by the graded session_status_check design fix. Behavioral and structural signals show near-zero correlation (r²=0.003) but the frozen conjunctive rule requires p<0.05, which is underpowered at n=240 for |r|~0.05 (audit confirms this is a sample-size limitation, not evidence of non-orthogonality). C-FRESHNESS remains EXPERIMENTAL. Claim ceiling bounded to: session_invalidation behavioral variance without TP dilution is achievable via graded session_status_check intensity (401/403/500) while keeping session_change=1; behavioral-structural orthogonality is plausible (|r|=0.053) but not formally confirmed at p<0.05.

product_action: No product action. C3 fails the frozen conjunctive gate. The architecture implication is precautionary: product pipeline should use composite multi-signal classifiers rather than independent parallel channels until orthogonality is confirmed at larger n.
next_question: Can a pooled paired-sample orthogonality test with n>=480 (doubling current sample size) confirm |r|<0.3 with permutation p<0.05 for behavioral-structural signals under graded session_status_check variance without TP dilution?
reason: The frozen decision rule requires ALL four criteria (C1-C4) for PASS. C1 and C2 pass decisively: mean TP=1.0 (Wilson lower 0.886 > 0.75) and 8/8 conditions have within-condition variance for both behavioral and structural signals, confirming the graded session_status_check fix resolves the TP/variance trade-off from the parent experiment. C4 passes with FP=0.0 on 120 noise-only samples. However, C3 fails the frozen conjunctive test: |r|=0.0527 < 0.3 (passes magnitude gate) but permutation p=0.414 > 0.05 (fails significance gate). The audit correctly identifies this as a sample-size limitation: at true |r|~0.05 and n=240, the permutation test has very low power to achieve p<0.05. The correlation is near-zero (r²=0.003, behavioral explains 0.3% of structural variance), and per-drift-pattern correlations are homogeneous (PB r=0.051, SI r=0.046), eliminating the heterogeneous SI-driven artifact from the parent. The frozen rule is the binding constraint; the Director does not override it. Maximum justified ceiling: TP/variance trade-off broken, orthogonality plausible but not confirmed. Product consequence: composite multi-signal classifiers as precautionary architecture.
